ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized scarring and specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation across 95% of the visible area; distinct high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) clustered on the right lobe and medial region; scattered high-intensity white speckles concentrated near the central notch and peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing edge; significant macro-level jagged protrusions at the distal tips caused by biological encrustation; pixel-amplitude of variations is higher on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the median notch toward the distal tips; convex lower boundary tapering from the peduncle to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 7-9 distinct high-contrast white circular rings on the right lobe and 3-4 smaller rings in the central lower region, representing localized pigment loss.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast horizontal linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, cutting through the primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of protruding brownish-white biological growth (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, significantly altering the geometric boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white pixel splashing/speckling pattern at the base of the fluke near the water line, distinct from the larger rosette scars.
